name: Kenneth Chen Ko Han
tagline: Also just a passenger on this train

photos.alt: Kenneth as a kid, at the ice rink

bio: I build AI systems that ship to production — computer vision pipelines, speech recognition, voice agents. Most of my work sits at the intersection of "make the model work" and "make it work reliably"

experience.description: San Francisco startup backed by Afore Capital, with $250K in pre-seed funding. I designed and run the technical interview loop, assessing the engineering candidates the founders shortlist.

Co-founded non-profit with YellowRibbon.gov.sg, HTX, and Singapore Prison Service. AI-powered resume services now delivered to 600+ users. Collaborating with SPD (Society for the Physically Disabled); hosted a sharing session training career facilitators on using the platform. Awarded SGD 24,000 in funding by the National Youth Council. Signed 12-month MOU with YellowRibbon. Featured in The Business Times and [Lianhe Zaobao](https://www.zaobao.com.sg/realtime/singapore/story20250729-7237751).
experience.tech: Next.js, LLM Agents, OpenAI API, ElevenLabs, Vercel, Render, Supabase, SQL

experience.description: Built the full-stack system that analyses Air Traffic Control situations: an NVIDIA NeMo speech recognition and speaker diarisation layer (finetuned parakeet-tdt, canary-1b and NGPU-LM) feeding a Qwen3 reasoning layer served with vLLM, deployed to edge devices for real-time transcription in the control room. Built an LLM-powered internal search tool at a RAiD hackathon hosted at Microsoft's office.
experience.tech: NVIDIA NeMo, vLLM, Qwen3, PyTorch, Edge Deployment

experience.description: Series A startup building synthetic data solutions for AI companies, backed by Sequoia Capital. Prototyped a zero-shot method with JinaCLIP to visualise missing data for NASA, BigBear AI and DSTA. Trained YOLOv6-lite for military tank detection with ST Engineering's Unmanned Vehicles Team; tuning for incremental learning lifted accuracy 16%+. Fine-tuned a StabilityAI VAE for synthetic-to-real domain adaptation.

Video Analytics team, Data Science and AI Division. Red-teamed GovTech's AI Image Detector with custom-trained LoRAs. Lead AI engineer on a computer vision pipeline for MSO's OneService App on AWS (EKS, SageMaker), classifying thousands of daily municipal reports via zero-shot ensembles. Built real-time animal welfare detection for NParks with OWLv2, tuned by Bayesian optimisation (Hyperopt). Prototyped a novel object-detection explainability method using SegGPT and SAM.
